title: The Almost Mixtape
author: D. M. Sterling
blurb: Mirabel Villalobos, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
